description: This header file defines functions for constructing and manipulating filesystem paths within a git repository, including paths for worktrees, submodules, and common git directories. It also includes utilities for path normalization, permission adjustments, and configuration home directory resolution.

methods.name: mkpath
methods.description: Returns a statically allocated path based on a printf-like format.

methods.name: mkpathdup
methods.description: Returns a freshly allocated duplicate of the constructed path.

methods.name: repo_common_path
methods.description: Constructs a path into a repository's shared git directory.

methods.name: repo_git_path
methods.description: Constructs a path into a repository's git directory.

methods.name: worktree_git_path
methods.description: Constructs a path into a specific worktree's git directory.

methods.name: repo_worktree_path
methods.description: Constructs a path into a repository's worktree.

methods.name: repo_submodule_path
methods.description: Constructs a path into a submodule's git directory.

methods.name: report_linked_checkout_garbage
methods.description: Reports garbage linked to a checkout in the repository.

methods.name: git_path_squash_msg
methods.description: Gets the path to the squash merge message file.

methods.name: git_path_merge_msg
methods.description: Gets the path to the merge message file.

methods.name: git_path_merge_rr
methods.description: Gets the path to the merge rejection file.

methods.name: git_path_merge_mode
methods.description: Gets the path to the merge mode file.

methods.name: git_path_merge_head
methods.description: Gets the path to the merge head file.

methods.name: git_path_fetch_head
methods.description: Gets the path to the fetch head file.

methods.name: git_path_shallow
methods.description: Gets the path to the shallow file.

methods.name: ends_with_path_components
methods.description: Checks if a path ends with specified components.

methods.name: calc_shared_perm
methods.description: Calculates shared permissions for a repository.

methods.name: adjust_shared_perm
methods.description: Adjusts permissions for a shared repository path.

methods.name: interpolate_path
methods.description: Interpolates environment variables into a path.

methods.name: remove_leading_path
methods.description: Removes a leading prefix from a path.

methods.name: relative_path
methods.description: Computes the relative path from a prefix.

methods.name: normalize_path_copy_len
methods.description: Normalizes a path with length info.

methods.name: normalize_path_copy
methods.description: Copies and normalizes a path.

methods.name: strbuf_normalize_path
methods.description: Normalizes the path stored in a strbuf.

methods.name: longest_ancestor_length
methods.description: Finds the length of the longest ancestor path.

methods.name: strip_path_suffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix from a path.

methods.name: daemon_avoid_alias
methods.description: Checks if a path should avoid aliasing in daemon mode.

methods.name: is_ntfs_dotgit
methods.description: Checks if a name is '.git' for NTFS.

methods.name: is_ntfs_dotgitmodules
methods.description: Checks if a name is '.gitmodules' for NTFS.

methods.name: is_ntfs_dotgitignore
methods.description: Checks if a name is '.gitignore' for NTFS.

methods.name: is_ntfs_dotgitattributes
methods.description: Checks if a name is '.gitattributes' for NTFS.

methods.name: is_ntfs_dotmailmap
methods.description: Checks if a name is '.mailmap' for NTFS.

methods.name: looks_like_command_line_option
methods.description: Determines if a string looks like a command line option.

methods.name: xdg_config_home_for
methods.description: Constructs path for XDG config home with subdirectory and filename.

methods.name: xdg_config_home
methods.description: Constructs path for XDG git config home.

methods.name: xdg_cache_home
methods.description: Constructs path for XDG git cache home.

methods.name: safe_create_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory with appropriate permissions.

methods.name: safe_create_dir_in_gitdir
methods.description: Creates a directory inside git dir, resolving gitlink files.

methods.name: safe_create_leading_directories
methods.description: Creates leading directories safely, adjusting permissions.

methods.name: safe_create_leading_directories_const
methods.description: Creates leading directories from a constant path.

methods.name: safe_create_leading_directories_no_share
methods.description: Creates leading directories without sharing permissions.

methods.name: safe_create_file_with_leading_directories
methods.description: Creates a file with its leading directories created
